newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Galore says can't explain share trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Galore says can't explain share trade.

text.p: About 10 percent of the issued shares of barbeque maker Galore Group Ltd changed hands in morning trade on the Australian Stock Exchange but a spokesman for Galore said he was unaware of the reason behind the trade.
At 12.30 p.m. (0130 GMT), about 8.07 million Galore shares were traded with the share price up 0.5 cents up at 39 cents.

The Galore spokesman said he was not sure whether the trade was in connection with the group's planned capital reduction programme. Under the plan Galore expects to pay A$20.0 million for shares in the group not held by some company executives.
Approval for the capital reduction will be sought at the comnpany's annual meeting on November 18.
